editorial:
Ever wonder what your pets are actually doing when you leave the house? You get a front-row seat to the chaos in this funny animated short. You will meet Squeak and Scratch, two house cats who absolutely cannot stand each other. The whole vibe is like a classic cartoon where everything is a competition. Whether it is fighting over the best spot on the couch or trying to trick the owners, these two spend every second trying to outsmart one another. It is a lighthearted ride that captures that silly, moody energy cats are famous for.

What really works here is the fast pacing and the physical comedy that makes you laugh out loud. While the animation is simple, the expressions on the cats' faces tell you everything you need to know. If you want something quick and breezy, this is a perfect pick for a family movie night.
endingExplained: The movie wraps up with one final, giant fight that accidentally destroys most of the living room. Just as the cats think they have won, the owners walk through the door and see the mess. Both Squeak and Scratch get put in time-out together. The twist is that being forced to sit still makes them realize they actually enjoy each other's company. They end the movie as unlikely friends, sharing a bowl of treats in peace.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves silly animals and classic cartoons
